name: add_pointer
description: Add a pointer; it gets the next free id (q1, q2, …).

name: reorder_pointers
description: Move a pointer to a position (0 is first).

name: set_document
description: Replace the JSON document the pointers resolve in.

name: resolve
description: Where any pointer leads in the document: its unescaped tokens, and the value it reaches, or the segment where it fails and why.

name: find
description: The pointers of nodes whose key or (scalar) value contains a text, ignoring case (at most 50).
